title: DeliveryEstimator PIN validation narrowed to six digits
query: What breaks if DeliveryEstimator.estimate narrows its PIN guard from [0-9]{4,10} to [0-9]{6,10} inside shipment-service?

affected_repositories.name: shipment-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: DeliveryEstimator is called by ShipmentService for estimates and confirmed orders; 4-5 digit PINs now throw UnsupportedDestinationException

notes: Single-repo control record. DeliveryEstimator is referenced only inside shipment-service (ShipmentService plus DeliveryEstimatorTest), so a strong contestant reports exactly one repository and no contracts. This checks the precision side of the thesis.
